title_sq: Vile Individuale per shitje tek Olive Park Residences!
description_sq:
Olive Park Residences karakterizohet nga nje arkitekture moderne, linjat e pastra dhe te lexueshme, thjeshtesia ne forme dhe funksionalitet si dhe volumet me hapesire e plot drite.
Vila ne fjale, eshte nje nga vilat me interesante dhe me pozicionimin me te mire ne kompleks.
Siperfaqja ndertimore e viles eshte 402,9m2
Siperfaqja e parceles eshte 633m2
Ne katin -1 149.7 m2 kemi ambjentet e kantines apo perdorime te tjera preferenciale si kinema, ambjent argetimi etj, nje lavanteri dhe nje tualet. Kati -1 merr ndricim natural. 
Ne katin perdhes (0) 123.2 m2 jane salloni dhe ambjenti i kuzhines, nga keto ambjente mund te aksesohen lehtesisht kopshti dhe pishina. Si dhe 1 dhome gjumi e ideuar per miqte.
Kati i pare 130 m2 i viles perfshin tre dhoma gjumi dhe 2 tualete. 
Dhoma Matrimoniale perfshin ambjentin e fjetjes, garderobe dhe nje tualet te brendshem. Dhome e paisur me vetrate te gjere qe mundeson drite maksimale.
Ne kete kat ndodhen dhe dy dhoma gjumi te tjera te cilat perdorin nje tualet te perbashket.
Pishina vjen si nje element i miremenduar qe ploteson peisazhin e gjelbert te kopshtit, ne cdo vile te kompleksit.
Rezidenca ofron per rezidentet e saj privatesi dhe siguri maksimale, fale hyrje-daljeve te kontrolluara dhe perfshirjes se sherbimit te mirembajtjes.
Per me shume informacione me kontaktoni!
title_en: Individual villas for sale at Olive Park Residences!
description_en: Olive Park Residences is characterized by a modern architecture, clean and readable lines, simplicity in form and functionality, as well as volumes with space and full of light. The villa in question is one of the most interesting villas with the best location in the complex. The construction area of ​​the villa is 402.9m2. The area of ​​the plot is 633m2. On the -1st floor, 149.7 m2, we have the premises of the winery or other preferential uses such as a cinema, entertainment area, etc., a laundry room and a toilet. Floor -1 receives natural light. On the ground floor (0) 123.2 m2 are the living room and the kitchen area, from these areas the garden and the pool can be easily accessed. As well as 1 bedroom designed for friends. The 130 m2 first floor of the villa includes three bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. The Matrimonial Room includes a sleeping area, a wardrobe and an internal toilet. Room equipped with wide windows that allow maximum light. On this floor there are two other bedrooms that use a common toilet. The pool comes as a well-thought-out element that completes the green landscape of the garden, in every villa of the complex. The residence offers its residents maximum privacy and security, thanks to controlled entrances and exits and the inclusion of maintenance service. For more information contact me!
